title: 第629章 姜家被迫退走成功进入遗迹广场第628章 第三把仙钥姜家欲抢夺
slug: 开局签到帝经我家族独断万古
lines: 湖面上，姜家五名天骄狼狈地站在半空中，每个人的脸上都写满了难以置信。
五人联手，最低都是天仙五重天的修为，甚至有一人达到了天仙八重天，结果居然被一个半步天仙的小子打得如此狼狈？
这简直是在颠覆他们的认知！
“不可能……这绝对不可能！”
那个被林轩一拳轰进湖里的姜家弟子咬着牙，脸色铁青，“你一定是隐藏了修为，你根本不是半步天仙。”
“你到底是谁？”
他实在无法接受这个事实。
他在姜家虽然算不上最顶尖的天骄，但也算是两家年轻一代中的佼佼者，天仙七重天的修为放在外面足以横着走。
结果居然被一个半步天仙一拳打断了十几根骨头。
这要是传出去，他以后在姜家还怎么抬得起头？
林轩淡淡地看了他一眼，语气平静无比：“信不信，那是你们的事，我没义务向你们证明什么。”
对此
“哼！一起上，全力出手。”
领头那名天仙八重天的姜家弟子大喝一声，“我就不信我们五个人，还拿不下他。”
他心中憋着一股火。
作为姜家核心弟子，他何时受过这等屈辱。
而且还是被一个境界远低于自己的人打成这样。
他绝对不能接受！
“没错，都动用压箱底的手段，不要留手。”
另一人也跟着喊道，“这小子邪门得很，不能把他当普通半步天仙看待。”
五人再次暴起，这一次他们显然动用了全力，各种压箱底的手段层出不穷。
领头那人浑身燃烧起金色的火焰，那是姜家的一门顶级仙术。
只见他的气势瞬间攀升了一大截，整个人如同一团金色的烈日。
还有一人周身环绕着凌厉的剑气，整个人化作一柄人形利剑，那是他的本命剑道，虽然远远不如林轩的混沌剑道那般霸道，但也颇具威势。
其他三人也是纷纷施展各自的强大攻击，气势磅礴。
“小子，给我们……死！”那五人同时大喝起来。
瞬间，五道攻击从五个方向同时轰向林轩，声势浩大，几乎封死了他所有的退路。
“哼，我看你这次还怎么躲。”领头那人狞笑道，眼中满是快意。
他就不信，面对这样的围攻，一个半步天仙还能翻出什么浪花来。
然而林轩站在原地，看着五道攻击同时逼近，面色依旧平静如水。
他的目光清澈而沉稳，没有一丝慌乱。
然后下一刻。
只见他身形一晃，直冲无视他们的攻击，朝着姜家五人冲了过去。
而面对那五人的攻击，林轩手握圣渊剑浑身剑意大盛。
“神避！”
随着他一道轻语响起，一道巨大的带着暗红色闪电的剑气，被他猛的劈出，瞬间和那五道攻击碰撞在一起。
“轰隆隆……”
瞬间天地间响起一声巨响。
content_en:
On the lake, the five geniuses of the Jiang family stood awkwardly in mid-air, with disbelief written all over their faces.
Five people joined forces, all of whom were at least the fifth level of heavenly immortals, and one even reached the eighth level of heavenly immortals, but they were beaten so embarrassingly by a boy who was half-step to heaven?
This is simply subverting their cognition!
"Impossible...This is absolutely impossible!"
The Jiang family disciple who was punched into the lake by Lin Xuan gritted his teeth and turned pale, "You must be hiding your cultivation. You are not a half-step immortal at all."
"Who are you anyway?"
He really couldn't accept this fact.
Although he is not the top genius in the Jiang family, he can still be regarded as a leader among the younger generation of the family. His cultivation level in the seventh level of heaven is enough to walk sideways.
As a result, a dozen bones were broken by a punch from a half-step immortal.
If word of this spreads, how will he be able to hold his head high in the Jiang family in the future?
Lin Xuan glanced at him indifferently and said in a very calm tone: "Believe it or not, that is your business. I have no obligation to prove anything to you."
In this regard
"Hmph! Come together and attack with all your strength."
The leading disciple of the Jiang family from the eighth level of heaven shouted, "I don't believe that the five of us can't defeat him."
There was a fire in his heart.
As a core disciple of the Jiang family, when had he ever experienced such humiliation?
And he was beaten like this by someone whose level was far lower than his own.
He absolutely cannot accept it!
"That's right, use all means to keep the bottom of the box, don't hold back."
Another person also shouted, "This kid is very evil. You can't treat him like an ordinary half-step immortal."
The five people broke out again, and this time they obviously used all their strength, using various means to suppress the situation.
The leader's whole body was burning with golden flames, which was a top-notch magical skill of the Jiang family.
I saw that his aura instantly increased a lot, and his whole person was like a golden sun.
There was another person surrounded by fierce sword energy, and his whole person turned into a human-shaped sword. That was his natal swordsmanship. Although it was far less domineering than Lin Xuan's chaotic swordsmanship, it was still quite powerful.
The other three people also launched their own powerful attacks one after another, with majestic momentum.
"Boy, give us...die!" The five people shouted at the same time.
"Boom!"
In an instant, five attacks hit Lin Xuan from five directions at the same time. They were so powerful that they almost blocked all his escape routes.
"Hmph, let's see how you can hide this time." The leader said with a evil smile, his eyes full of pleasure.
He didn't believe that in the face of such a siege, what kind of tricks could a half-step immortal do?
However, Lin Xuan stood there, watching the five attacks approaching at the same time, his face still as calm as water.
His eyes were clear and steady, without any trace of panic.
And then the next moment.
He was seen swaying, ignoring their attacks, and rushing towards the five Jiang family members.
Facing the attacks of those five people, Lin Xuan held the Holy Abyss Sword in his hand and his whole body was full of sword intent.
"God avoids!"
As he whispered, a huge sword energy with dark red lightning was slashed out by him, and it instantly collided with the five attacks.
"Rumble..."
In an instant, there was a loud noise between heaven and earth.
